fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2026-01-21, around 20:40, an unidentified customer allegedly took hardware goods worth Rs. 3,50,000 from Sri Vel Hardware near Kadal Nagar Bus Stand Area in Coimbatore, according to the complaint recorded on 2026-01-21. Jeeva Krishnan submitted the complaint online using the mobile number 9000000414. The complainant is associated with the business Sri Vel Hardware. Ramesh Pandian (9000000469) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant alleged that Madhan Murugan may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000216. The complaint refers to Venkat Palanisamy, an intermediary, reachable on 9000000134. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement and CCTV footage. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00291, as the mobile number 9000000216 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as a customer and took items while staff were attending to others.
fields.Keywords: shop theft, stock, CCTV, witness statement, suspect, bus stand, associate, witness
